[This is a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding (bid = my value) is a weakly dominant strategy: I win whenever my value exceeds others' values and pay the second-highest value, maximizing expected payoff. Other rational bidders will follow the same logic, so shading bids offers no advantage. Given v = 18 and one round only, I will bid 18. This strategy is robust to beliefs about opponents and ties are resolved randomly, not affecting the dominance of truthful bidding.]
